results.question: What are the names of the people who teach math courses?
results.predicted_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.Name
FROM teacher t
JOIN course_arrange ca ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
JOIN course c ON ca.Course_ID = c.Course_ID
WHERE c.Course LIKE '%math%'
results.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID  =  T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T3.Teacher_ID WHERE T2.Course  =  "Math"

results.question: What is the ship id and name that caused most total injuries?
results.predicted_sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM death d
JOIN ship s ON d.caused_by_ship_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY SUM(d.injured) DESC
LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.id ,  T2.name FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
